overview: Stepping straight out of an urban rendition of "Romy and Michelle", Donna and Ally are two black sex workers who have transformed the trials of a 12-year run from the law into a relentless pursuit of legendary status. Their world, encapsulated in raw humor and undying hope, promises non-stop laughter. Unraveling a narrative that is as authentic as it is captivating, they prove that there's no force mightier than a woman with a dream.
